namespace MeasureTheory
variable {α F F' 𝕜 : Type*} {p : ℝ≥0∞} [RCLike 𝕜]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] [CompleteSpace F']
  {m m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α} {f g : α → F'} {s : Set α}

variable [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

theorem toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_of_forall_setLIntegral_eq (hm : m ≤ m0)
    {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} {s : Set α} (hs₀ : MeasurableSet[m0] s) (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] g μ)
    (hg_int_finite : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[m] t → μ t < ∞ → ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ ≠ ⊤)
    (hg_eq : ∀ t : Set α, MeasurableSet[m] t → μ t < ∞ → ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ = μ (s ∩ t)) :
    (fun a ↦ (g a).toReal) =ᵐ[μ] μ[s.indicator 1|m] := by
  have : AEStronglyMeasurable[m0] g μ := hgm.mono hm
  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (f := s.indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
    hm (by fun_prop (disch := measurability))
    (fun t ht hμt ↦ (integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top
      (hgm.mono hm).aemeasurable.restrict (hg_int_finite t ht hμt)))
    (fun t ht hμt ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have hg_ae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, g x < ∞ := ae_lt_top' (hgm.mono hm).aemeasurable.restrict
      (by simpa [Measure.restrict_restrict (hm _ ht)] using hg_int_finite t ht hμt)
    calc
      ∫ x in t, (g x).toReal ∂μ = ∫ x in t ∩ s, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by
        simp [integral_toReal (hgm.mono hm).aemeasurable.restrict hg_ae, hg_eq t ht hμt,
          measureReal_def, Set.inter_comm]
      _ = ∫ x in t, s.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x ∂μ := by
        rw [← setIntegral_indicator hs₀]
  · exact hgm.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable.ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
      (hgm.ae_eq_mk.fun_comp ENNReal.toReal).symm

lemma toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_iff_forall_meas_inter_eq (hm : m ≤ m0)
    [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet[m0] s)
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] g μ) (hg : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, g a ≠ ∞) :
    (fun a ↦ (g a).toReal) =ᵐ[μ] μ[s.indicator 1| m] ↔
      ∀ t, MeasurableSet[m] t → μ (s ∩ t) = ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ := by
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    have hint : Integrable (fun a ↦ (g a).toReal) μ :=
      (integrable_condExp (m := m) (f := s.indicator (1 : α → ℝ))).congr h.symm
    have h1 : ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ = ∫⁻ a in t, ENNReal.ofReal (g a).toReal ∂μ :=
      lintegral_congr_ae (by
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae hg] with a ha
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal ha])
    rw [h1, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint.integrableOn
      (ae_of_all _ fun a ↦ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)]
    rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae h),
      setIntegral_condExp (f := s.indicator (1 : α → ℝ)) hm
        ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator hs) ht]
    have : ∫ a in t, s.indicator (1 : α → ℝ) a ∂μ = μ.real (s ∩ t) := by
      rw [integral_indicator hs]
      simp [Measure.restrict_restrict hs, measureReal_def]
    rw [this, measureReal_def, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _)]
  · intro h
    exact toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_of_forall_setLIntegral_eq hm hs hgm
      (fun t ht _ ↦ by rw [← h t ht]; exact measure_ne_top _ _)
      (fun t ht _ ↦ (h t ht).symm)

end MeasureTheory

namespace ProbabilityTheory.Kernel
variable {X : Type*} {𝓑 𝓧 : MeasurableSpace X} {π : Kernel[𝓑, 𝓧] X X} {μ : Measure[𝓧] X}
  {A B : Set X} {f g : X → ℝ≥0∞} {x₀ : X}

@[mk_iff]
class IsCondExp (π : Kernel[𝓑, 𝓧] X X) (μ : Measure[𝓧] X) : Prop where
  condExp_ae_eq_kernel_apply ⦃A : Set X⦄ : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A →
    μ[A.indicator 1| 𝓑] =ᵐ[μ] fun a ↦ (π a A).toReal

lemma isCondExp_iff_bind_eq_left (hπ : π.IsProper) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    IsCondExp π μ ↔ μ.bind π = μ := by
  have hmeas : ∀ {A : Set X}, MeasurableSet[𝓧] A → AEStronglyMeasurable[𝓑] (fun a ↦ π a A) μ :=
    fun hA ↦ (π.measurable_coe hA).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [isCondExp_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hu := h MeasurableSet.univ
    have hfin : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, π a Set.univ ≠ ∞ := by
      have h1 : μ[(Set.univ : Set X).indicator (1 : X → ℝ)|𝓑] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ) := by
        have : (Set.univ : Set X).indicator (1 : X → ℝ) = fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ) := by
          ext x; simp
        rw [this]
        exact Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (condExp_const h𝓑𝓧 (1 : ℝ))
      filter_upwards [hu, h1] with a ha1 ha2 ha3
      have h0 : ((π a) Set.univ).toReal = 0 := by rw [ha3]; rfl
      rw [h0] at ha1
      rw [ha1] at ha2
      exact zero_ne_one ha2
    refine Measure.ext fun A hA ↦ ?_
    have key := (toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_iff_forall_meas_inter_eq h𝓑𝓧
      (μ := μ) (g := fun a ↦ π a A) (s := A) hA (hmeas hA)
      (by filter_upwards [hfin] with a ha
          exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ha (measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)))).mp (h hA).symm
    rw [eq_comm, Measure.bind_apply hA (π.measurable.mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).aemeasurable]
    simpa using key _ .univ
  · intro h A hA

  [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] [CompleteSpace F']
  {m m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α} {f g : α → F'} {s : Set α}

variable [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

theorem toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_of_forall_setLIntegral_eq (hm : m ≤ m0)
    {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} {s : Set α} (hs₀ : MeasurableSet[m0] s) (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] g μ)
    (hg_int_finite : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[m] t → μ t < ∞ → ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ ≠ ⊤)
    (hg_eq : ∀ t : Set α, MeasurableSet[m] t → μ t < ∞ → ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ = μ (s ∩ t)) :
    (fun a ↦ (g a).toReal) =ᵐ[μ] μ[s.indicator 1|m] := by
  have : AEStronglyMeasurable[m0] g μ := hgm.mono hm
  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (f := s.indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
    hm (by fun_prop (disch := measurability))
    (fun t ht hμt ↦ integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top (hgm.mono hm).aemeasurable.restrict
      (hg_int_finite t ht hμt))
    (fun t ht hμt ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have hg_ae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, g x < ∞ := ae_lt_top' (hgm.mono hm).aemeasurable.restrict
      (by simpa [Measure.restrict_restrict (hm _ ht)] using hg_int_finite t ht hμt)
    calc
      ∫ x in t, (g x).toReal ∂μ = ∫ x in t ∩ s, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by
        simp [integral_toReal (hgm.mono hm).aemeasurable.restrict hg_ae, hg_eq t ht hμt,
          measureReal_def, Set.inter_comm]
      _ = ∫ x in t, s.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x ∂μ := by
        rw [← setIntegral_indicator hs₀]
  · exact hgm.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable.ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
      (hgm.ae_eq_mk.fun_comp ENNReal.toReal).symm

lemma toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_iff_forall_meas_inter_eq (hm : m ≤ m0)
    [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] {g : α → ℝ≥0∞} {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet[m0] s)
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] g μ) (hg : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, g a ≠ ⊤) :
    (fun a ↦ (g a).toReal) =ᵐ[μ] μ[s.indicator 1| m] ↔
      ∀ t, MeasurableSet[m] t → μ (s ∩ t) = ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ := by
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    have hint : Integrable (s.indicator (1 : α → ℝ)) μ :=
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator hs
    have hgi : Integrable (fun a ↦ (g a).toReal) μ :=
      (integrable_condExp (m := m) (f := s.indicator (1 : α → ℝ))).congr h.symm
    have h1 : ∫⁻ a in t, g a ∂μ = ∫⁻ a in t, ENNReal.ofReal ((g a).toReal) ∂μ :=
      lintegral_congr_ae ((ae_restrict_of_ae hg).mono fun a ha ↦ (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal ha).symm)
    rw [h1, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hgi.integrableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a ↦ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)]
    rw [setIntegral_congr_ae (hm t ht) (h.mono fun a ha _ ↦ ha), setIntegral_condExp hm hint ht,
      setIntegral_indicator hs]
    simp [Set.inter_comm, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _), measureReal_def]
  · intro h
    exact toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_of_forall_setLIntegral_eq hm hs hgm
      (fun t ht _ ↦ by rw [← h t ht]; exact measure_ne_top _ _) (fun t ht _ ↦ (h t ht).symm)

end MeasureTheory

variable {X : Type*} {𝓑 𝓧 : MeasurableSpace X} {π : Kernel[𝓑, 𝓧] X X} {μ : Measure[𝓧] X}
  {A B : Set X} {f g : X → ℝ≥0∞} {x₀ : X}

@[mk_iff]
class IsCondExp (π : Kernel[𝓑, 𝓧] X X) (μ : Measure[𝓧] X) : Prop where
  condExp_ae_eq_kernel_apply ⦃A : Set X⦄ : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A →
    μ[A.indicator 1| 𝓑] =ᵐ[μ] fun a ↦ (π a A).toReal

lemma isCondExp_iff_bind_eq_left (hπ : π.IsProper) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    IsCondExp π μ ↔ μ.bind π = μ := by
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.trim h𝓑𝓧) := isFiniteMeasure_trim h𝓑𝓧
  have haem : AEMeasurable (fun x₀ ↦ π x₀) μ := (π.measurable.mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).aemeasurable
  have hgm : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[𝓧] A → AEStronglyMeasurable[𝓑] (fun a ↦ π a A) μ :=
    fun A hA ↦ (π.measurable_coe hA).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hgm' : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[𝓧] A → AEMeasurable (fun a ↦ π a A) μ :=
    fun A hA ↦ ((π.measurable_coe hA).mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).aemeasurable
  rw [isCondExp_iff]
  simp_rw [Filter.eventuallyEq_comm]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := h MeasurableSet.univ
    rw [Set.indicator_univ] at h1
    have hc : μ[(1 : X → ℝ)|𝓑] = fun _ ↦ 1 := condExp_const h𝓑𝓧 1
    have h1' : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, π a Set.univ ≠ ⊤ := by
      filter_upwards [h1] with a ha
      have hb := congrFun hc a
      have : (π a Set.univ).toReal = 1 := by
        rw [ha]; exact hb
      intro htop
      rw [htop] at this
      simp at this
    refine Measure.ext fun A hA ↦ ?_
    rw [Measure.bind_apply hA haem]
    have hg : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, π a A ≠ ⊤ := h1'.mono fun a ha hb ↦
      ha (top_unique (hb ▸ measure_mono (Set.subset_univ A)))
    have := (toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_iff_forall_meas_inter_eq h𝓑𝓧 hA (hgm A hA) hg).1
      (h hA) Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
    simpa using this.symm
  · intro h A hA
    have hg : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, π a A ≠ ⊤ := by
      have : ∫⁻ a, π a A ∂μ ≠ ⊤ := by
        rw [← Measure.bind_apply hA haem, h]; exact measure_ne_top _ _
      exact (ae_lt_top' (hgm' A hA) this).mono fun a ha ↦ ha.ne
    refine (toReal_ae_eq_indicator_condExp_iff_forall_meas_inter_eq h𝓑𝓧 hA (hgm A hA) hg).2 ?_
    intro t ht
    rw [hπ.setLIntegral_eq_comp h𝓑𝓧 hA ht]
    rw [h]

end ProbabilityTheory.Kernel

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}
    (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Δ] B) {f₁ f₂ : S → E} (h : ∀ i ∈ Δ, f₁ i = f₂ i) :
    f₁ ∈ B ↔ f₂ ∈ B := by
  unfold cylinderEvents at hB
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_iSup] at hB
  refine hB.recOn (fun s ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun _ _ ih ↦ ih.not) (fun _ _ ih ↦ by simp [ih])
  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

variable {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] {Δ : Set ι}

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (Δ : Set ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ =
      MeasurableSpace.comap Δ.domRestrict (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (∀ i : Δ, X i)) := by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    (measurable_restrict_cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ).comap_le
  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_le_comap_of_eq_comp (fun x : ∀ i : Δ, X i ↦ x ⟨i, hi⟩)

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_finsetRestrict (Λ : Finset ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) (Λ : Set ι) =
      MeasurableSpace.comap (Λ.restrict (π := X))
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Π i : Λ, X i)) :=
  cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (X := X) (Λ : Set ι)

variable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {f : (∀ i, X i) → Z}

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := by
      rw [measurable_pi_iff]
      intro i
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simp only [e, h, dite_true]
        exact measurable_pi_apply _
      · simp only [e, h, dite_false]
        exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact .comp (hf.comp he) (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

    Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f ↔ Measurable f ∧ DependsOn f Δ :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl, h.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents⟩,
    fun h ↦ h.1.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn h.2⟩

variable {S E : Type*} {𝓔 : MeasurableSpace E} {Λ s : Set S} {t : S → Set E} {η : S → E} {x : S}

noncomputable def juxt (Λ : Set S) (η : S → E) (ζ : Λ → E) (x : S) : E := by
  classical exact dite (x ∈ Λ) (fun h ↦ ζ ⟨x, h⟩) (fun _ ↦ η x)

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_mem (hx : x ∈ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = ζ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by simp [juxt, hx]

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_not_mem (h : x ∉ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = η x := by simp [juxt, h]

protected lemma Measurable.juxt : Measurable (juxt Λ η) := by
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  rintro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Λ <;> simp [juxt, hx, measurable_pi_apply]

lemma preimage_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ := by
  ext ζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hjs
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs
    · simp
  · by_cases hiΛ : i ∈ Λ
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem hiΛ, hi] using h ⟨i, hiΛ⟩
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hη i ⟨hi, hiΛ⟩

lemma preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty (hη : η ∉ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro ζ hζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi] at hζ hη
  push Not at hη
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨his, hiΛ⟩, hit⟩ := hη
  exact hit <| by simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hζ i his

lemma map_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (μ : Measure (Λ → E))
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (hs : s.Countable) (η : S → E) :
    μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) =
      ((s \ Λ).pi t).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ μ (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ)) η := by
  rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (MeasurableSet.pi hs fun i _ ↦ ht i)]
  by_cases hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi hη, indicator_of_mem hη]
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty hη, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hη]

lemma measurable_map_juxt_pi (μ : Measure (Λ → E)) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i))
    (hs : s.Countable) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents (X := fun _ : S ↦ E) Λᶜ] fun η : S → E ↦
      μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [map_juxt_pi μ ht hs]
  exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const
    (MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents (fun _ h ↦ h.2) (hs.mono sdiff_subset) fun i _ ↦ ht i)

end juxt

variable {S E : Type*} {mE : MeasurableSpace E}

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}
    (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Δ] B) {f₁ f₂ : S → E} (h : ∀ i ∈ Δ, f₁ i = f₂ i) :
    f₁ ∈ B ↔ f₂ ∈ B := by
  unfold cylinderEvents at hB
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_iSup] at hB
  refine hB.recOn (fun s ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun _ _ ih ↦ ih.not) (fun _ _ ih ↦ by simp [ih])
  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

namespace MeasureTheory

variable {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] {Δ : Set ι}

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (Δ : Set ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ =
      MeasurableSpace.comap Δ.domRestrict (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (∀ i : Δ, X i)) := by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    (measurable_restrict_cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ).comap_le
  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_le_comap_of_eq_comp (fun x : ∀ i : Δ, X i ↦ x ⟨i, hi⟩)
    (measurable_pi_apply _) rfl

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_finsetRestrict (Λ : Finset ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) (Λ : Set ι) =
      MeasurableSpace.comap (Λ.restrict (π := X))
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Π i : Λ, X i)) :=
  cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (X := X) (Λ : Set ι)

variable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {f : (∀ i, X i) → Z}

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := by
      refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i ↦ ?_
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simpa [e, h] using measurable_pi_apply (⟨i, h⟩ : Δ)
      · simp only [e, h, dite_false]
        exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact .comp (hf.comp he) (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

theorem measurable_cylinderEvents_iff_dependsOn [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f ↔ Measurable f ∧ DependsOn f Δ :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl, h.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents⟩,
    fun h ↦ h.1.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn h.2⟩

variable (ι) (X) in
abbrev measurableSquareCylinders : Set (Set (∀ i, X i)) :=
  squareCylinders fun _ ↦ {s | MeasurableSet s}

protected lemma IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders :
    IsPiSystem (measurableSquareCylinders ι X) :=
  isPiSystem_squareCylinders (fun _ ↦ MeasurableSpace.isPiSystem_measurableSet)
    fun _ ↦ MeasurableSet.univ

lemma generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders :
    MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (measurableSquareCylinders ι X) = MeasurableSpace.pi :=
  generateFrom_squareCylinders

lemma univ_mem_measurableSquareCylinders :
    (univ : Set (∀ i, X i)) ∈ measurableSquareCylinders ι X :=
  ⟨∅, fun _ ↦ univ, fun _ _ ↦ MeasurableSet.univ, by simp⟩

lemma _root_.MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents {s : Set ι} (hs : s ⊆ Δ) (hsc : s.Countable)
    {t : ∀ i, Set (X i)} (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (t i)) :
    MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ] (s.pi t) := by
  rw [pi_def]
  exact MeasurableSet.biInter hsc fun i hi ↦
    (ht i hi).preimage (measurable_cylinderEvent_apply (hs hi))

end MeasureTheory

variable {S E : Type*} {𝓔 : MeasurableSpace E} {Λ s : Set S} {t : S → Set E} {η : S → E} {x : S}

noncomputable def juxt (Λ : Set S) (η : S → E) (ζ : Λ → E) (x : S) : E := by
  classical exact dite (x ∈ Λ) (fun h ↦ ζ ⟨x, h⟩) (fun _ ↦ η x)

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_mem (hx : x ∈ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = ζ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by simp [juxt, hx]

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_not_mem (h : x ∉ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = η x := by simp [juxt, h]

protected lemma Measurable.juxt : Measurable (juxt Λ η) := by
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  rintro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Λ <;> simp [juxt, hx, measurable_pi_apply]

lemma preimage_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ := by
  ext ζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hjs
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs
    · simp
  · by_cases hiΛ : i ∈ Λ
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem hiΛ, hi] using h ⟨i, hiΛ⟩
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hη i ⟨hi, hiΛ⟩

lemma preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty (hη : η ∉ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro ζ hζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi] at hζ hη
  push Not at hη
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨his, hiΛ⟩, hit⟩ := hη
  exact hit <| by simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hζ i his

lemma map_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (μ : Measure (Λ → E))
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (hs : s.Countable) (η : S → E) :
    μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) =
      ((s \ Λ).pi t).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ μ (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ)) η := by
  rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (MeasurableSet.pi hs fun i _ ↦ ht i)]
  by_cases hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi hη, indicator_of_mem hη]
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty hη, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hη]

lemma measurable_map_juxt_pi (μ : Measure (Λ → E)) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i))
    (hs : s.Countable) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents (X := fun _ : S ↦ E) Λᶜ] fun η : S → E ↦
      μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [map_juxt_pi μ ht hs]
  exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const
    (MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents (fun _ h ↦ h.2) (hs.mono sdiff_subset) fun i _ ↦ ht i)

end juxt

lemma measurable_isssdFun (Λ : Finset S) :

  have h : ∀ η : S → E,
      IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (juxt (Λ : Set S) η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)) :=

  refine Measurable.measure_of_isPiSystem_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩

    (fun i ↦ ht i (mem_univ _)) s.countable_toSet

@[simps -fullyApplied]
def isssdFun (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (Λ : Finset S) :
    Kernel[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] (S → E) (S → E) :=
  @Kernel.mk _ _ (_) _
    (fun η ↦ Measure.map (juxt Λ η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν))
    (measurable_isssdFun (ν := ν) Λ)

instance instIsMarkovKernel_isssdFun {Λ : Finset S} : IsMarkovKernel (isssdFun ν Λ) := by
  have h : ∀ η : S → E,
      IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (juxt (Λ : Set S) η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)) :=
    fun η ↦ Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map Measurable.juxt.aemeasurable
  exact ⟨h⟩

lemma isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E)
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (η : S → E) :
    isssdFun ν Λ η ((s : Set S).pi t) =
      (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t).indicator (fun _ ↦ ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) η := by
  have hprod :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
        (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ) =
      ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i) := by
    rw [Measure.pi_pi]
    simp only [apply_ite, measure_univ]
    exact (Finset.prod_attach Λ fun i : S ↦ if i ∈ s then ν (t i) else 1).trans <| by
      simp [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.inter_comm]
  rw [isssdFun_apply, map_juxt_pi _ ht s.countable_toSet η]
  simp [Finset.coe_sdiff, hprod]

lemma isssdFun_comp_isssdFun [DecidableEq S] (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S) :
    (isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ isssdFun ν Λ₂ =
      (isssdFun ν (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)).comap id
        (measurable_id'' <| by gcongr; exact Finset.subset_union_right)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsMarkovKernel ((isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi)) :=
    ⟨fun a ↦ by
      show IsProbabilityMeasure (isssdFun ν Λ₁ a)
      infer_instance⟩
  refine DFunLike.ext _ _ fun η ↦ ext_of_generateFrom_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have ht' (i) : MeasurableSet (t i) := ht i (mem_univ _)
  rw [Kernel.comp_apply, Measure.bind_apply
    (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht' i) (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  simp_rw [Kernel.comap_apply, id_eq]
  have h1 := lintegral_isssdFun_pi (ν := ν) (μ := isssdFun ν Λ₂ η) Λ₁ s t ht'

  rw [isssdFun_pi Λ₂ (s \ Λ₁) t ht' η,
    isssdFun_pi (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂) s t ht' η, ← indicator_const_mul]

  · ext; simp
  ext
  rw [← Finset.prod_inter_mul_prod_sdiff (s ∩ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)) Λ₁ fun i ↦ ν (t i)]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.inter_assoc, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 Finset.subset_union_left]
  · rw [Finset.inter_sdiff_assoc, Finset.union_sdiff_left, Finset.inter_comm,

noncomputable def juxt (Λ : Set S) (η : S → E) (ζ : Λ → E) (x : S) : E := by
  classical exact dite (x ∈ Λ) (fun h ↦ ζ ⟨x, h⟩) (fun _ ↦ η x)

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_mem (hx : x ∈ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = ζ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by simp [juxt, hx]

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_not_mem (h : x ∉ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = η x := by simp [juxt, h]

protected lemma Measurable.juxt : Measurable (juxt Λ η) := by
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  rintro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Λ <;> simp [juxt, hx, measurable_pi_apply]

lemma preimage_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ := by
  ext ζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hjs
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs
    · simp
  · by_cases hiΛ : i ∈ Λ
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem hiΛ, hi] using h ⟨i, hiΛ⟩
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hη i ⟨hi, hiΛ⟩

lemma preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty (hη : η ∉ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro ζ hζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi] at hζ hη
  push Not at hη
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨his, hiΛ⟩, hit⟩ := hη
  exact hit <| by simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hζ i his

lemma map_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (μ : Measure (Λ → E))
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (hs : s.Countable) (η : S → E) :
    μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) =
      ((s \ Λ).pi t).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ μ (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ)) η := by
  rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (MeasurableSet.pi hs fun i _ ↦ ht i)]
  by_cases hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi hη, indicator_of_mem hη]
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty hη, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hη]

lemma measurable_map_juxt_pi (μ : Measure (Λ → E)) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i))
    (hs : s.Countable) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents (X := fun _ : S ↦ E) Λᶜ] fun η : S → E ↦
      μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [map_juxt_pi μ ht hs]
  exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const
    (MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents (fun _ h ↦ h.2) (hs.mono sdiff_subset) fun i _ ↦ ht i)

end juxt

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}
    (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Δ] B) {f₁ f₂ : S → E} (h : ∀ i ∈ Δ, f₁ i = f₂ i) :

  refine hB.recOn (fun s ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun _ _ ih ↦ ih.not) (fun _ _ ih ↦ by simp [ih])
  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i => by
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simp only [e, dif_pos h]; exact measurable_pi_apply _
      · simp only [e, dif_neg h]; exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact .comp (hf.comp he) (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

lemma isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E)
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (η : S → E) :
    isssdFun ν Λ η ((s : Set S).pi t) =
      (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t).indicator (fun _ ↦ ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) η := by
  have hprod :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)

      ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i) := by

    simp only [apply_ite, measure_univ]

      simp [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.inter_comm]

      (∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) * μ (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t) := by
  simp_rw [isssdFun_pi Λ s t ht]

    (isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ isssdFun ν Λ₂ =
      (isssdFun ν (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)).comap id
        (measurable_id'' <| by gcongr; exact Finset.subset_union_right) := by
  haveI h1 : IsMarkovKernel ((isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi)) :=
    ⟨fun a ↦ by
      show IsProbabilityMeasure (isssdFun ν Λ₁ a)
      infer_instance⟩
  refine DFunLike.ext _ _ fun η ↦ ext_of_generateFrom_of_isProbabilityMeasure

  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have ht' (i) : MeasurableSet (t i) := ht i (mem_univ _)
  rw [Kernel.comp_apply, Measure.bind_apply
    (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht' i) (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  show ∫⁻ a, isssdFun ν Λ₁ a ((s : Set S).pi t) ∂(isssdFun ν Λ₂ η) =

    isssdFun_pi Λ₂ (s \ Λ₁) t ht' η,
    isssdFun_pi (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂) s t ht' η, ← indicator_const_mul]
  congr 1
  · ext; simp
  ext
  rw [← Finset.prod_inter_mul_prod_sdiff (s ∩ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)) Λ₁ fun i ↦ ν (t i)]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.inter_assoc, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 Finset.subset_union_left]
  · rw [Finset.inter_sdiff_assoc, Finset.union_sdiff_left, Finset.inter_comm,

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}

  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

  cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (X := X) (Λ : Set ι)

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := by
      rw [measurable_pi_iff]
      intro i
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simp only [e, h, dite_true]
        exact measurable_pi_apply _
      · simp only [e, h, dite_false]
        exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact .comp (hf.comp he) (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl, h.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents⟩,
    fun h ↦ h.1.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn h.2⟩

      (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
        (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ) =
      ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i) := by

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}
    (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Δ] B) {f₁ f₂ : S → E} (h : ∀ i ∈ Δ, f₁ i = f₂ i) :
    f₁ ∈ B ↔ f₂ ∈ B := by
  unfold cylinderEvents at hB
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_iSup] at hB
  refine hB.recOn (fun s ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun _ _ ih ↦ ih.not) (fun _ _ ih ↦ by simp [ih])
  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

variable {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] {Δ : Set ι}

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (Δ : Set ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ =
      MeasurableSpace.comap Δ.domRestrict (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (∀ i : Δ, X i)) := by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    (measurable_restrict_cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ).comap_le
  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_le_comap_of_eq_comp (fun x : ∀ i : Δ, X i ↦ x ⟨i, hi⟩)
    (measurable_pi_apply _) rfl

    cylinderEvents (X := X) (Λ : Set ι) =
      MeasurableSpace.comap (Λ.restrict (π := X))
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Π i : Λ, X i)) :=
  cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (X := X) (Λ : Set ι)

variable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {f : (∀ i, X i) → Z}

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i => by
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simp only [e, h, dite_true]
        exact measurable_pi_apply _
      · simp only [e, h, dite_false]
        exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact (hf.comp he).comp (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

    Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f ↔ Measurable f ∧ DependsOn f Δ :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl, h.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents⟩,
    fun h ↦ h.1.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn h.2⟩

lemma juxt_apply_of_mem (hx : x ∈ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = ζ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by simp [juxt, hx]

  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  rintro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Λ <;> simp [juxt, hx, measurable_pi_apply]

lemma preimage_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ := by
  ext ζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hjs
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs
    · simp
  · by_cases hiΛ : i ∈ Λ
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem hiΛ, hi] using h ⟨i, hiΛ⟩
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hη i ⟨hi, hiΛ⟩

lemma preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty (hη : η ∉ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro ζ hζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi] at hζ hη
  push Not at hη
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨his, hiΛ⟩, hit⟩ := hη
  exact hit <| by simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hζ i his

lemma map_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (μ : Measure (Λ → E))
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (hs : s.Countable) (η : S → E) :
    μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) =
      ((s \ Λ).pi t).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ μ (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ)) η := by
  rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (MeasurableSet.pi hs fun i _ ↦ ht i)]
  by_cases hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi hη, indicator_of_mem hη]
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty hη, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hη]

lemma measurable_map_juxt_pi (μ : Measure (Λ → E)) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i))
    (hs : s.Countable) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents (X := fun _ : S ↦ E) Λᶜ] fun η : S → E ↦
      μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [map_juxt_pi μ ht hs]
  exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const
    (MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents (fun _ h ↦ h.2) (hs.mono sdiff_subset) fun i _ ↦ ht i)

end juxt

    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs

  haveI : ∀ η : S → E, IsProbabilityMeasure ((Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν).map (juxt Λ η)) :=
    fun η ↦ Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map Measurable.juxt.aemeasurable
  refine Measurable.measure_of_isPiSystem_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact measurable_map_juxt_pi (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
    (fun i ↦ ht i (mem_univ _)) s.countable_toSet

@[simps -fullyApplied]
def isssdFun (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (Λ : Finset S) :
    Kernel[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] (S → E) (S → E) :=
  @Kernel.mk _ _ (_) _
    (fun η ↦ Measure.map (juxt Λ η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν))
    (measurable_isssdFun (ν := ν) Λ)

instance instIsMarkovKernel_isssdFun {Λ : Finset S} : IsMarkovKernel (isssdFun ν Λ) :=
  ⟨fun η ↦ by
    simp only [isssdFun_apply]
    exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map Measurable.juxt.aemeasurable⟩

lemma isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E)
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (η : S → E) :
    isssdFun ν Λ η ((s : Set S).pi t) =
      (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t).indicator (fun _ ↦ ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) η := by
  have hprod :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
        (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ) =
      ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i) := by
    rw [Measure.pi_pi]
    simp only [apply_ite, measure_univ]
    exact (Finset.prod_attach Λ fun i : S ↦ if i ∈ s then ν (t i) else 1).trans <| by
      simp [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.inter_comm]
  rw [isssdFun_apply, map_juxt_pi _ ht s.countable_toSet η]
  simp [Finset.coe_sdiff, hprod]

lemma lintegral_isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] {μ : Measure (S → E)}
    (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) :
    ∫⁻ ω, isssdFun ν Λ ω ((s : Set S).pi t) ∂μ =
      (∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) * μ (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t) := by
  simp_rw [isssdFun_pi Λ s t ht]
  exact lintegral_indicator_const (MeasurableSet.pi (s \ Λ).countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht i) _

lemma isssdFun_comp_isssdFun [DecidableEq S] (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S) :
    (isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (measurable_id.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl) ∘ₖ isssdFun ν Λ₂ =
      (isssdFun ν (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)).comap id
        (measurable_id'' <| by gcongr; exact Finset.subset_union_right) := by
  refine DFunLike.ext _ _ fun η ↦ ext_of_generateFrom_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have ht' (i) : MeasurableSet (t i) := ht i (mem_univ _)
  rw [Kernel.comp_apply, Measure.bind_apply
    (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht' i) (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  simp_rw [Kernel.comap_apply, id_eq]
  rw [lintegral_isssdFun_pi Λ₁ s t ht',
    isssdFun_pi Λ₂ (s \ Λ₁) t ht' η,
    isssdFun_pi (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂) s t ht' η, ← indicator_const_mul]
  congr 1
  · ext; simp
  ext
  rw [← Finset.prod_inter_mul_prod_sdiff (s ∩ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)) Λ₁ fun i ↦ ν (t i)]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.inter_assoc, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 Finset.subset_union_left]
  · rw [Finset.inter_sdiff_assoc, Finset.union_sdiff_left, Finset.inter_comm,
      Finset.inter_sdiff_left_comm]

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}
    (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Δ] B) {f₁ f₂ : S → E} (h : ∀ i ∈ Δ, f₁ i = f₂ i) :

  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_iSup] at hB
  refine hB.recOn (fun s ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun _ _ ih ↦ ih.not) (fun _ _ ih ↦ by simp [ih])
  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Π i : Λ, X i)) :=
  cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (X := X) (Λ : Set ι)

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := by
      refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i ↦ ?_
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simp only [e, h, dite_true]
        exact measurable_pi_apply _
      · simp only [e, h, dite_false]
        exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact (hf.comp he).comp (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

noncomputable def juxt (Λ : Set S) (η : S → E) (ζ : Λ → E) (x : S) : E := by
  classical exact dite (x ∈ Λ) (fun h ↦ ζ ⟨x, h⟩) (fun _ ↦ η x)

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_mem (hx : x ∈ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = ζ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by simp [juxt, hx]

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_not_mem (h : x ∉ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = η x := by simp [juxt, h]

protected lemma Measurable.juxt : Measurable (juxt Λ η) := by
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  rintro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Λ <;> simp [juxt, hx, measurable_pi_apply]

lemma preimage_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ := by
  ext ζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hjs
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs
    · simp
  · by_cases hiΛ : i ∈ Λ
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem hiΛ, hi] using h ⟨i, hiΛ⟩
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hη i ⟨hi, hiΛ⟩

lemma preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty (hη : η ∉ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro ζ hζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi] at hζ hη
  push Not at hη
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨his, hiΛ⟩, hit⟩ := hη
  exact hit <| by simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hζ i his

lemma map_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (μ : Measure (Λ → E))
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (hs : s.Countable) (η : S → E) :
    μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) =
      ((s \ Λ).pi t).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ μ (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ)) η := by
  rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (MeasurableSet.pi hs fun i _ ↦ ht i)]
  by_cases hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi hη, indicator_of_mem hη]
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty hη, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hη]

lemma measurable_map_juxt_pi (μ : Measure (Λ → E)) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i))
    (hs : s.Countable) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents (X := fun _ : S ↦ E) Λᶜ] fun η : S → E ↦
      μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [map_juxt_pi μ ht hs]
  exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const
    (MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents (fun _ h ↦ h.2) (hs.mono sdiff_subset) fun i _ ↦ ht i)

end juxt

@[mk_iff]
class IsCondExp (π : Kernel[𝓑, 𝓧] X X) (μ : Measure[𝓧] X) : Prop where
  condExp_ae_eq_kernel_apply ⦃A : Set X⦄ : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A →
    μ[A.indicator 1| 𝓑] =ᵐ[μ] fun a ↦ (π a A).toReal

lemma isCondExp_iff_bind_eq_left (hπ : π.IsProper) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    IsCondExp π μ ↔ μ.bind π = μ := by
  have hAmeas : ∀ A : Set X, MeasurableSet[𝓧] A → AEMeasurable (fun a ↦ π a A) μ := fun A hA ↦
    ((Kernel.measurable_coe π hA).mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).aemeasurable
  have hπaem : AEMeasurable (fun a ↦ π a) μ := (π.measurable.mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).aemeasurable
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine Measure.ext fun A hA ↦ ?_
    rw [Measure.bind_apply hA hπaem]
    have hu := h.condExp_ae_eq_kernel_apply (MeasurableSet.univ : MeasurableSet[𝓧] Set.univ)
    have hc : μ[(Set.univ : Set X).indicator (1 : X → ℝ)|𝓑] = fun _ ↦ 1 := by
      rw [Set.indicator_univ]; exact condExp_const h𝓑𝓧 (1 : ℝ)
    rw [hc] at hu

      filter_upwards [hu] with a ha
      exact ENNReal.toReal_eq_one_iff _ |>.1 ha.symm
    have hA' : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, π a A = ENNReal.ofReal (μ[A.indicator 1|𝓑] a) := by
      filter_upwards [h.condExp_ae_eq_kernel_apply hA, h1] with a ha hπ1
      have hne : π a A ≠ ∞ :=
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by rw [hπ1]; exact ENNReal.one_ne_top)
          (measure_mono (Set.subset_univ A))
      rw [ha, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hne]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] μ[A.indicator (1 : X → ℝ)|𝓑] := by
      filter_upwards [h.condExp_ae_eq_kernel_apply hA] with a ha
      rw [Pi.zero_apply, ha]; exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    calc ∫⁻ a, π a A ∂μ = ∫⁻ a, ENNReal.ofReal (μ[A.indicator 1|𝓑] a) ∂μ := lintegral_congr_ae hA'
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ a, μ[A.indicator 1|𝓑] a ∂μ) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal integrable_condExp hnn).symm
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ a, A.indicator (1 : X → ℝ) a ∂μ) := by rw [integral_condExp h𝓑𝓧]
      _ = μ A := by
          rw [@integral_indicator_one X 𝓧 _ _ hA, measureReal_def,
            ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ A)]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun A hA ↦ ?_⟩
    have hbindA : ∫⁻ a, π a A ∂μ = μ A := by
      rw [← Measure.bind_apply hA hπaem, h]
    have hfin : ∫⁻ a, π a A ∂μ ≠ ∞ := by rw [hbindA]; exact measure_ne_top μ A
    have hint : Integrable (fun a ↦ (π a A).toReal) μ :=

    refine (ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (f := A.indicator (1 : X → ℝ)) h𝓑𝓧

    · intro t ht _

        rw [hπ.setLIntegral_eq_comp h𝓑𝓧 hA ht, h]
      have hfin' : ∫⁻ a in t, π a A ∂μ ≠ ∞ := by rw [hlin]; exact measure_ne_top μ _
      have hae : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.restrict t, π a A < ∞ := ae_lt_top' (hAmeas A hA).restrict hfin'
      calc ∫ a in t, (π a A).toReal ∂μ = (∫⁻ a in t, π a A ∂μ).toReal :=
            integral_toReal (hAmeas A hA).restrict hae
        _ = (μ (A ∩ t)).toReal := by rw [hlin]
        _ = ∫ a in t, A.indicator (1 : X → ℝ) a ∂μ := by
            rw [@integral_indicator_one X 𝓧 (μ.restrict t) A hA, measureReal_def,
              Measure.restrict_apply hA]
    · exact ((Kernel.measurable_coe π hA).ennreal_toReal.stronglyMeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable

lemma isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul :
    γ.IsProper ↔
      ∀ (Λ : Finset S) ⦃A : Set (S → E)⦄ (_hA : MeasurableSet A) ⦃B : Set (S → E)⦄
        (_hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] B) (η : S → E),
      γ Λ η (A ∩ B) = B.indicator 1 η * γ Λ η A :=
  forall_congr' fun _ ↦ Kernel.isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul cylinderEvents_le_pi

alias ⟨IsProper.inter_eq_indicator_mul, IsProper.of_inter_eq_indicator_mul⟩ :=
  isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul

lemma isGibbsMeasure_iff_forall_bind_eq (hγ : γ.IsProper) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    γ.IsGibbsMeasure μ ↔ ∀ Λ, μ.bind (γ Λ) = μ :=

noncomputable section ISSSD
variable {ν : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

lemma isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi {Λ : Finset S} (η : S → E) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (juxt (Λ : Set S) η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (Measurable.juxt (η := η)).aemeasurable

lemma measurable_isssdFun (Λ : Finset S) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents Λᶜ]
      fun η : S → E ↦ (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν).map (juxt Λ η) := by
  haveI : ∀ η : S → E, IsProbabilityMeasure
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν).map (juxt (Λ : Set S) η)) :=
    fun η ↦ isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi η
  refine Measurable.measure_of_isPiSystem_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact measurable_map_juxt_pi (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
    (fun i ↦ ht i (mem_univ _)) s.countable_toSet

@[simps -fullyApplied]
def isssdFun (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (Λ : Finset S) :
    Kernel[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] (S → E) (S → E) :=
  @Kernel.mk _ _ (_) _
    (fun η ↦ Measure.map (juxt Λ η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν))
    (measurable_isssdFun (ν := ν) Λ)

instance instIsMarkovKernel_isssdFun {Λ : Finset S} : IsMarkovKernel (isssdFun ν Λ) :=
  ⟨fun η ↦ isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi (ν := ν) (Λ := Λ) η⟩

lemma isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E)
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (η : S → E) :
    isssdFun ν Λ η ((s : Set S).pi t) =
      (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t).indicator (fun _ ↦ ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) η := by
  have hprod :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
        (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ) =
      ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i) := by
    rw [Measure.pi_pi]
    simp only [apply_ite, measure_univ]
    exact (Finset.prod_attach Λ fun i : S ↦ if i ∈ s then ν (t i) else 1).trans <| by
      simp [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.inter_comm]
  rw [isssdFun_apply, map_juxt_pi _ ht s.countable_toSet η]
  simp [Finset.coe_sdiff, hprod]

lemma lintegral_isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] {μ : Measure (S → E)}
    (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) :
    ∫⁻ ω, isssdFun ν Λ ω ((s : Set S).pi t) ∂μ =
      (∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) * μ (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t) := by
  simp_rw [isssdFun_pi Λ s t ht]
  exact lintegral_indicator_const (MeasurableSet.pi (s \ Λ).countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht i) _

lemma isssdFun_comp_isssdFun [DecidableEq S] (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S) :
    (isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ isssdFun ν Λ₂ =
      (isssdFun ν (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)).comap id
        (measurable_id'' <| by gcongr; exact Finset.subset_union_right) := by
  haveI : IsMarkovKernel ((isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi)) :=
    Kernel.IsMarkovKernel.comap _ _
  haveI : IsMarkovKernel ((isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ
      isssdFun ν Λ₂) := inferInstance
  refine DFunLike.ext _ _ fun η ↦ ext_of_generateFrom_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have ht' (i) : MeasurableSet (t i) := ht i (mem_univ _)
  rw [Kernel.comp_apply, Measure.bind_apply
    (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht' i) (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  simp_rw [Kernel.comap_apply, id_eq]
  erw [lintegral_isssdFun_pi Λ₁ s t ht']
  rw [isssdFun_pi Λ₂ (s \ Λ₁) t ht' η,
    isssdFun_pi (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂) s t ht' η, ← indicator_const_mul]
  congr 1
  · ext; simp
  ext
  rw [← Finset.prod_inter_mul_prod_sdiff (s ∩ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)) Λ₁ fun i ↦ ν (t i)]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.inter_assoc, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 Finset.subset_union_left]
  · rw [Finset.inter_sdiff_assoc, Finset.union_sdiff_left, Finset.inter_comm,
      Finset.inter_sdiff_left_comm]

@[simps]
def isssd (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] : Specification S E where
  toFun := isssdFun ν
  isConsistent' Λ₁ Λ₂ hΛ := by
    classical
    rw [isssdFun_comp_isssdFun]
    ext a s _
    simp only [Kernel.comap_apply, id_eq, isssdFun_apply, Finset.coe_sort_coe]
    rw [Finset.union_eq_right.2 hΛ]

lemma isssd_apply' (Λ : Finset S) : isssd (S := S) ν Λ = isssdFun ν Λ := rfl

protected lemma IsProper.isssd : (isssd (S := S) ν).IsProper :=
  .of_inter_eq_indicator_mul fun Λ A hA B hB x ↦ by
    simp only [isssd_apply', isssdFun_apply, Finset.coe_sort_coe]
    rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (hA.inter (cylinderEvents_le_pi _ hB)), Measure.map_apply .juxt hA,
      preimage_inter]
    have hxB (ζ) : juxt (↑Λ) x ζ ∈ B ↔ x ∈ B :=
      mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents hB fun _ hi ↦ juxt_apply_of_not_mem hi ζ
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · have : juxt (↑Λ) x ⁻¹' B = univ := by ext; simp [hxB, hx]
      rw [this, inter_univ, indicator_of_mem hx, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
    · have : juxt (↑Λ) x ⁻¹' B = ∅ := by ext; simp [hxB, hx]
      rw [this, inter_empty, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hx, zero_mul]

instance isssd.instIsMarkov : (isssd (S := S) ν).IsMarkov where
  isMarkovKernel Λ := ⟨fun η ↦ isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi (ν := ν) (Λ := Λ) η⟩

lemma isssd_pi {Λ s : Finset S} (hs : s ⊆ Λ) (t : S → Set E)
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (η : S → E) :
    isssd ν Λ η ((s : Set S).pi t) = ∏ i ∈ s, ν (t i) := by
  classical
  rw [isssd_apply', isssdFun_pi Λ s t ht,
    Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.2 hs]
  simp [Finset.inter_eq_left.2 hs]

lemma bind_isssd_pi (μ : Measure (S → E)) {Λ s : Finset S}
    (hs : s ⊆ Λ) (t : S → Set E) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) :
    μ.bind (isssd ν Λ) ((s : Set S).pi t) = μ univ * ∏ i ∈ s, ν (t i) := by
  rw [Measure.bind_apply (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht i)
    ((isssd ν Λ).measurable.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl).aemeasurable]
  simp_rw [isssd_pi hs t ht]
  rw [lintegral_const, mul_comm]

lemma infinitePi_bind_isssd (Λ : Finset S) :
    (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : S ↦ ν).bind (isssd ν Λ) =
      Measure.infinitePi fun _ : S ↦ ν := by
  classical
  refine Measure.eq_infinitePi (μ := fun _ : S ↦ ν) fun s t ht ↦ ?_
  rw [Measure.bind_apply (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht i)
    ((isssd ν Λ).measurable.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl).aemeasurable]
  simp_rw [isssd_apply']
  rw [lintegral_isssdFun_pi Λ s t ht,
    Measure.infinitePi_pi (μ := fun _ : S ↦ ν) fun i _ ↦ ht i]
  exact Finset.prod_inter_mul_prod_sdiff s Λ fun i ↦ ν (t i)

lemma isGibbsMeasure_isssd_infinitePi :
    (isssd ν).IsGibbsMeasure (.infinitePi fun _ : S ↦ ν) :=
  (isGibbsMeasure_iff_forall_bind_eq IsProper.isssd).2 infinitePi_bind_isssd

name: Specification.comp_modificationKer_apply
statement:
lemma comp_modificationKer_apply (hγ : γ.IsProper) (hρ : ∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ))
    (hΛ : Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂) (η : S → E) :
    ((modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₁).comap id (measurable_id'' cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ
      modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₂) η =
      (γ Λ₂ η).withDensity fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω
proof:
:= by
  ext A hA
  have hF : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]
      fun ζ ↦ ∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ :=
    (Measure.measurable_setLIntegral (hρ Λ₁) hA).comp (γ Λ₁).measurable
  have hG : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]
      fun ω ↦ ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := (hρ Λ₂).lintegral_kernel
  have hL : ((modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₁).comap id (measurable_id'' cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ
      modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₂) η A =
      ∫⁻ ζ, (∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ) * ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₂ η := by
    rw [Kernel.comp_apply' _ _ _ hA]
    simp_rw [Kernel.comap_apply', id_eq]
    nth_rw 1 [modificationKer_apply]
    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (hρ Λ₂)
      (((modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₁).measurable_coe hA).mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl)]
    exact lintegral_congr fun ζ ↦ by
      rw [Pi.mul_apply, modificationKer_apply, withDensity_apply _ hA, mul_comm]
  have hR : ((γ Λ₂ η).withDensity fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) A =

  have hF : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]

    (Measure.measurable_setLIntegral (hρ Λ₁) hA).comp (γ Λ₁).measurable

    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (hρ Λ₂)

      rw [Pi.mul_apply, modificationKer_apply, withDensity_apply _ hA, mul_comm]
  have hR : ((γ Λ₂ η).withDensity fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) A =

    rw [γ.lintegral_bind hΛ
      (f := fun ω ↦ (∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) * A.indicator (ρ Λ₁) ω)

    exact lintegral_congr fun ζ ↦ by
      rw [hγ.lintegral_mul _ ((hρ Λ₁).indicator hA) hG, lintegral_indicator hA]
  rw [hL, hR, γ.lintegral_bind hΛ
    (f := fun ζ ↦ (∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ) * ρ Λ₂ ζ)

    (hmeas : ∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ)) (η₂ : S → E)
    (hnorm : ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₁ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ η₂ = 1) :
    (ρ Λ₂ =ᵐ[γ Λ₁ η₂] fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) ↔
      ∀ᵐ z ∂(γ Λ₁ η₂).prod (γ Λ₁ η₂), ρ Λ₂ z.1 * ρ Λ₁ z.2 = ρ Λ₂ z.2 * ρ Λ₁ z.1
proof:
:= by
  have hG : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]
      fun ω ↦ ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := (hmeas Λ₂).lintegral_kernel
  have hGconst := (hγ Λ₁).ae_eq_const cylinderEvents_le_pi hG η₂

  · intro h
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae h,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae h,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hGconst,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hGconst] with z h1 h2 hG1 hG2
    rw [h1, h2, hG1, hG2]
    ac_rfl
  · intro h
    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h, hGconst] with ζ hζ hGζ
    have := lintegral_congr_ae hζ
    rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (hmeas Λ₁), lintegral_mul_const _ (hmeas Λ₂), hnorm, mul_one] at this
    rw [this, hGζ, mul_comm]

lemma IsProper.ae_eq_const (hπ : IsProper π) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧)

    rw [hπ.restrict_eq_indicator_smul h𝓑𝓧 hB x₀]
    simp [B]

  · ext a; simp [B]
  · simp

name: Specification.isModifier_iff_ae_comm
statement:
lemma isModifier_iff_ae_comm [DecidableEq S] [γ.IsMarkov] (hγ : γ.IsProper) (hindep : γ.IsIndep)
    (hnorm : ∀ Λ η, ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ ζ ∂γ Λ η = 1) :
    γ.IsModifier ρ ↔ (∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ)) ∧
      ∀ ⦃Λ₁ Λ₂⦄, Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂ → ∀ η₁, ∀ᵐ η₂ ∂γ (Λ₂ \ Λ₁) η₁,
        ∀ᵐ z ∂(γ Λ₁ η₂).prod (γ Λ₁ η₂), ρ Λ₂ z.1 * ρ Λ₁ z.2 = ρ Λ₂ z.2 * ρ Λ₁ z.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [isModifier_iff_ae_eq hγ]
  refine and_congr_right fun hmeas ↦ forall₄_congr fun Λ₁ Λ₂ hΛ η₁ ↦ ?_
  rw [ae_eq_mul_lintegral_iff_ae_eq_sdiff hindep hmeas hΛ η₁]
  exact Filter.eventually_congr <| .of_forall fun η₂ ↦
    ae_eq_mul_lintegral_iff_ae_mul_comm hγ hmeas η₂ (hnorm Λ₁ η₂)

variable {X : Type*} {𝓑 𝓧 : MeasurableSpace X} {π : Kernel[𝓑, 𝓧] X X} {A B : Set X}
  {f g : X → ℝ} {x₀ : X}

lemma IsProper.ae_eq_const (hπ : IsProper π) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧)
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSingletonClass Y] {g : X → Y}
    (hg : Measurable[𝓑] g) (x₀ : X) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂π x₀, g x = g x₀ := by
  let B := g ⁻¹' {g x₀}
  have hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B := hg (measurableSet_singleton _)
  have hB' := h𝓑𝓧 _ hB
  have hπB : π.restrict hB' x₀ = π x₀ := by
    rw [hπ.restrict_eq_indicator_smul h𝓑𝓧 hB x₀]
    simp [B]
  rw [ae_iff, ← hπB]
  convert restrict_apply' π hB' x₀ hB'.compl
  · ext a; simp [B]
  · simp

end ProbabilityTheory.Kernel

variable {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace β]

variable {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {s : Set α}

lemma measurable_restrict (hs : MeasurableSet s) : Measurable fun μ : Measure α ↦ μ.restrict s :=
  measurable_of_measurable_coe _ fun t ht ↦ by
    simp_rw [restrict_apply ht]; exact measurable_coe (ht.inter hs)

lemma measurable_setLIntegral {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Measurable fun μ : Measure α ↦ ∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ :=
  (measurable_lintegral hf).comp (measurable_restrict hs)

lemma bind_null {m : Measure α} {f : α → Measure β} {s : Set β}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf : AEMeasurable f m) :
    m.bind f s = 0 ↔ (fun a ↦ f a s) =ᵐ[m] 0 := by
  rw [bind_apply hs hf]
  exact lintegral_eq_zero_iff' (f := fun a ↦ f a s) <|
    (measurable_coe hs).comp_aemeasurable hf

theorem ae_bind_iff {m : Measure α} {f : α → Measure β} {p : β → Prop}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f m) (hp : MeasurableSet {x | p x}) :
    (∀ᵐ b ∂m.bind f, p b) ↔ ∀ᵐ a ∂m, ∀ᵐ b ∂f a, p b :=
  ⟨ae_ae_of_ae_bind hf, fun h ↦ by
    rwa [ae_iff, bind_null _ hf] at *
    exact hp.compl⟩

end MeasureTheory.Measure

variable {γ γ₁ γ₂ : Specification S E} {Λ Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S}

lemma lintegral_bind (hΛ : Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂) {f : (S → E) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (η : S → E) :
    ∫⁻ x, f x ∂γ Λ₂ η = ∫⁻ ζ, ∫⁻ x, f x ∂γ Λ₁ ζ ∂γ Λ₂ η := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← γ.isConsistent hΛ]
  rw [Kernel.lintegral_comp _ _ _ hf]
  rfl

def IsIndep (γ : Specification S E) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃Λ₁ Λ₂⦄ [DecidableEq S], (γ Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ γ Λ₂ =
      (γ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)).comap id (measurable_id'' <| by gcongr; exact Finset.subset_union_right)

lemma IsIndep.bind_eq_union [DecidableEq S] (hγ : γ.IsIndep) (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S) (η : S → E) :
    (γ Λ₂ η).bind (γ Λ₁) = γ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂) η :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (hγ (Λ₁ := Λ₁) (Λ₂ := Λ₂)) η

class IsMarkov (γ : Specification S E) : Prop where
  isMarkovKernel : ∀ Λ, IsMarkovKernel (γ Λ)

instance IsMarkov.toIsMarkovKernel [γ.IsMarkov] {Λ : Finset S} : IsMarkovKernel (γ Λ) :=
  isMarkovKernel _

def IsProper (γ : Specification S E) : Prop := ∀ Λ : Finset S, (γ Λ).IsProper

variable {A B : Set (S → E)} {f g : (S → E) → ℝ≥0∞} {η₀ : S → E}

lemma IsProper.lintegral_mul (hγ : γ.IsProper) (Λ : Finset S) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hg : Measurable[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] g) :
    ∫⁻ x, g x * f x ∂(γ Λ η₀) = g η₀ * ∫⁻ x, f x ∂(γ Λ η₀) :=
  (hγ _).lintegral_mul cylinderEvents_le_pi hf hg _

@[mk_iff]
structure IsModifier (γ : Specification S E) (ρ : Finset S → (S → E) → ℝ≥0∞) : Prop where
  measurable Λ : Measurable (ρ Λ)
  isConsistent : IsConsistent (modificationKer γ ρ measurable)

lemma comp_modificationKer_apply (hγ : γ.IsProper) (hρ : ∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ))
    (hΛ : Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂) (η : S → E) :
    ((modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₁).comap id (measurable_id'' cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ
      modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₂) η =
      (γ Λ₂ η).withDensity fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := by
  ext A hA
  have hF : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]
      fun ζ ↦ ∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ :=
    (Measure.measurable_setLIntegral (hρ Λ₁) hA).comp (γ Λ₁).measurable
  have hG : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]
      fun ω ↦ ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := (hρ Λ₂).lintegral_kernel
  have hL : ((modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₁).comap id (measurable_id'' cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ
      modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₂) η A =
      ∫⁻ ζ, (∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ) * ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₂ η := by
    rw [Kernel.comp_apply' _ _ _ hA]
    simp_rw [Kernel.comap_apply', id_eq]
    nth_rw 1 [modificationKer_apply]
    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (hρ Λ₂)
      (((modificationKer γ ρ hρ Λ₁).measurable_coe hA).mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl)]
    exact lintegral_congr fun ζ ↦ by
      rw [Pi.mul_apply, modificationKer_apply, withDensity_apply _ hA, mul_comm]
  have hR : ((γ Λ₂ η).withDensity fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) A =
      ∫⁻ ζ, (∫⁻ ξ, ρ Λ₂ ξ ∂γ Λ₁ ζ) * (∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ) ∂γ Λ₂ η := by
    rw [withDensity_apply _ hA, ← lintegral_indicator hA]
    simp_rw [mul_comm (ρ Λ₁ _), indicator_mul_right]
    rw [γ.lintegral_bind hΛ
      (f := fun ω ↦ (∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) * A.indicator (ρ Λ₁) ω)
      ((hG.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl).mul ((hρ Λ₁).indicator hA)) η]
    exact lintegral_congr fun ζ ↦ by
      rw [hγ.lintegral_mul _ ((hρ Λ₁).indicator hA) hG, lintegral_indicator hA]
  rw [hL, hR, γ.lintegral_bind hΛ
    (f := fun ζ ↦ (∫⁻ ω in A, ρ Λ₁ ω ∂γ Λ₁ ζ) * ρ Λ₂ ζ)
    ((hF.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl).mul (hρ Λ₂)) η]
  exact lintegral_congr fun ζ ↦ by rw [hγ.lintegral_mul _ (hρ Λ₂) hF, mul_comm]

lemma isModifier_iff_ae_eq [γ.IsMarkov] (hγ : γ.IsProper) :
    γ.IsModifier ρ ↔ (∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ)) ∧ ∀ ⦃Λ₁ Λ₂⦄, Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂ → ∀ η,
      ρ Λ₂ =ᵐ[γ Λ₂ η] fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.measurable, fun Λ₁ Λ₂ hΛ η ↦ ?_⟩
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun (h.isConsistent hΛ) η
    rw [comp_modificationKer_apply hγ h.measurable hΛ, modificationKer_apply] at this
    exact (withDensity_eq_iff_of_sigmaFinite (h.measurable Λ₂).aemeasurable
      ((h.measurable Λ₁).mul
        ((h.measurable Λ₂).lintegral_kernel.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl)).aemeasurable).1
      this.symm
  · rintro ⟨hmeas, hb⟩
    refine ⟨hmeas, fun Λ₁ Λ₂ hΛ ↦ Kernel.ext fun η ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [comp_modificationKer_apply hγ hmeas hΛ, modificationKer_apply]
    exact (withDensity_congr_ae (hb hΛ η)).symm

lemma ae_eq_mul_lintegral_iff_ae_mul_comm [IsMarkovKernel (γ Λ₁)] (hγ : γ.IsProper)
    (hmeas : ∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ)) (η₂ : S → E)
    (hnorm : ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₁ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ η₂ = 1) :
    (ρ Λ₂ =ᵐ[γ Λ₁ η₂] fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) ↔
      ∀ᵐ z ∂(γ Λ₁ η₂).prod (γ Λ₁ η₂), ρ Λ₂ z.1 * ρ Λ₁ z.2 = ρ Λ₂ z.2 * ρ Λ₁ z.1 := by
  have hG : Measurable[cylinderEvents (Λ₁ : Set S)ᶜ]
      fun ω ↦ ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := (hmeas Λ₂).lintegral_kernel
  have hGconst := (hγ Λ₁).ae_eq_const cylinderEvents_le_pi hG η₂
  constructor
  · intro h
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae h,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae h,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hGconst,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hGconst] with z h1 h2 hG1 hG2
    rw [h1, h2, hG1, hG2]
    ac_rfl
  · intro h
    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h, hGconst] with ζ hζ hGζ
    have := lintegral_congr_ae hζ
    rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (hmeas Λ₁), lintegral_mul_const _ (hmeas Λ₂), hnorm, mul_one] at this
    rw [this, hGζ, mul_comm]

lemma ae_eq_mul_lintegral_iff_ae_eq_sdiff [DecidableEq S] (hindep : γ.IsIndep)
    (hmeas : ∀ Λ, Measurable (ρ Λ)) (hΛ : Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂) (η₁ : S → E) :
    (ρ Λ₂ =ᵐ[γ Λ₂ η₁] fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω) ↔
      ∀ᵐ η₂ ∂γ (Λ₂ \ Λ₁) η₁,
        ρ Λ₂ =ᵐ[γ Λ₁ η₂] fun ω ↦ ρ Λ₁ ω * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω := by
  have hG : Measurable fun ω : S → E ↦ ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂γ Λ₁ ω :=
    ((hmeas Λ₂).lintegral_kernel).mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl
  have hμ : (γ (Λ₂ \ Λ₁) η₁).bind (γ Λ₁) = γ Λ₂ η₁ :=
    (hindep.bind_eq_union Λ₁ (Λ₂ \ Λ₁) η₁).trans <| by rw [Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hΛ]
  rw [← hμ]
  exact Measure.ae_bind_iff ((γ Λ₁).measurable.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl).aemeasurable
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (hmeas Λ₂) ((hmeas Λ₁).mul hG))

section IsProper

def IsProper (γ : Specification S E) : Prop := ∀ Λ : Finset S, (γ Λ).IsProper

lemma isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul :
    γ.IsProper ↔
      ∀ (Λ : Finset S) ⦃A : Set (S → E)⦄ (_hA : MeasurableSet A) ⦃B : Set (S → E)⦄
        (_hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] B) (η : S → E),
      γ Λ η (A ∩ B) = B.indicator 1 η * γ Λ η A :=
  forall_congr' fun _ ↦ Kernel.isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul cylinderEvents_le_pi

alias ⟨IsProper.inter_eq_indicator_mul, IsProper.of_inter_eq_indicator_mul⟩ :=
  isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul

variable {A B : Set (S → E)} {f g : (S → E) → ℝ≥0∞} {η₀ : S → E}

lemma IsProper.setLIntegral_inter_eq_indicator_mul_setLIntegral (Λ : Finset S) (hγ : γ.IsProper)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] B) :
    ∫⁻ x in A ∩ B, f x ∂(γ Λ η₀) = B.indicator 1 η₀ * ∫⁻ x in A, f x ∂(γ Λ η₀) :=
  (hγ Λ).setLIntegral_inter_eq_indicator_mul_setLIntegral cylinderEvents_le_pi hf hA hB _

end IsProper

lemma IsPremodifier.mul_lintegral_isssd {ν : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hρ : IsPremodifier ρ) (hΛ : Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂) (ξ : S → E) :
    ρ Λ₂ ξ * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₁ ζ ∂isssd ν Λ₁ ξ = ρ Λ₁ ξ * ∫⁻ ζ, ρ Λ₂ ζ ∂isssd ν Λ₁ ξ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isssd_toFun, isssdFun_apply]
  rw [lintegral_map (hρ.measurable Λ₁) .juxt, lintegral_map (hρ.measurable Λ₂) .juxt]
  let Λ : Set S := Λ₁
  have h1 : Measurable fun ζ : Λ → E ↦ ρ Λ₁ (juxt Λ ξ ζ) := (hρ.measurable Λ₁).comp .juxt
  have h2 : Measurable fun ζ : Λ → E ↦ ρ Λ₂ (juxt Λ ξ ζ) := (hρ.measurable Λ₂).comp .juxt
  rw [← lintegral_const_mul (ρ Λ₂ ξ) h1, ← lintegral_const_mul (ρ Λ₁ ξ) h2]
  exact lintegral_congr fun ζ ↦
    (mul_comm _ _).trans <| (hρ.comm_of_subset (ζ := juxt Λ ξ ζ) (η := ξ) hΛ
      fun s hs ↦ juxt_apply_of_not_mem hs ζ).symm.trans (mul_comm _ _)

open Function MeasureTheory Set

variable {S E : Type*} {mE : MeasurableSpace E}

lemma mem_congr_of_measurableSet_cylinderEvents {Δ : Set S} {B : Set (S → E)}
    (hB : MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents Δ] B) {f₁ f₂ : S → E} (h : ∀ i ∈ Δ, f₁ i = f₂ i) :
    f₁ ∈ B ↔ f₂ ∈ B := by
  unfold cylinderEvents at hB
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_iSup] at hB
  refine hB.recOn (fun s ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun _ _ ih ↦ ih.not) (fun _ _ ih ↦ by simp [ih])
  by_cases hiΔ : i ∈ Δ
  · rw [iSup_pos hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hi
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp only [mem_preimage, h i hiΔ]
  · rw [iSup_neg hiΔ, MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> exact iff_of_eq rfl

namespace MeasureTheory

variable {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] {Δ : Set ι}

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (Δ : Set ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ =
      MeasurableSpace.comap Δ.domRestrict (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (∀ i : Δ, X i)) := by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    (measurable_restrict_cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ).comap_le
  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_le_comap_of_eq_comp (fun x : ∀ i : Δ, X i ↦ x ⟨i, hi⟩)
    (measurable_pi_apply _) rfl

lemma cylinderEvents_eq_comap_finsetRestrict (Λ : Finset ι) :
    cylinderEvents (X := X) (Λ : Set ι) =
      MeasurableSpace.comap (Λ.restrict (π := X))
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Π i : Λ, X i)) :=
  cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict (X := X) (Λ : Set ι)

variable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {f : (∀ i, X i) → Z}

theorem _root_.Measurable.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
    (hf : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f) : DependsOn f Δ :=
  dependsOn_iff_factorsThrough.2 <| by
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict] at hf
    exact hf.factorsThrough

theorem _root_.Measurable.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn
    (hf : Measurable f) (hdep : DependsOn f Δ) : Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ i, X i) with hα | hα
  · intro s _
    convert MeasurableSet.empty
    exact eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hα
    let e : (∀ i : Δ, X i) → ∀ i, X i := fun y i ↦ if h : i ∈ Δ then y ⟨i, h⟩ else x₀ i
    have hfe : f = (f ∘ e) ∘ Δ.domRestrict := by
      funext x
      refine (hdep fun i hi ↦ ?_).symm
      simp [e, hi, Set.domRestrict]
    have he : Measurable e := by
      refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i ↦ ?_
      by_cases h : i ∈ Δ
      · simp only [e, dif_pos h]
        exact measurable_pi_apply _
      · simp only [e, dif_neg h]
        exact measurable_const
    rw [cylinderEvents_eq_comap_domRestrict, hfe]
    exact Measurable.comp (hf.comp he) (.of_comap_le le_rfl)

theorem measurable_cylinderEvents_iff_dependsOn [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents Δ] f ↔ Measurable f ∧ DependsOn f Δ :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.mono cylinderEvents_le_pi le_rfl, h.dependsOn_of_cylinderEvents⟩,
    fun h ↦ h.1.cylinderEvents_of_dependsOn h.2⟩

variable (ι) (X) in
abbrev measurableSquareCylinders : Set (Set (∀ i, X i)) :=
  squareCylinders fun _ ↦ {s | MeasurableSet s}

protected lemma IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders :
    IsPiSystem (measurableSquareCylinders ι X) :=
  isPiSystem_squareCylinders (fun _ ↦ MeasurableSpace.isPiSystem_measurableSet)
    fun _ ↦ MeasurableSet.univ

lemma generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders :
    MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (measurableSquareCylinders ι X) = MeasurableSpace.pi :=
  generateFrom_squareCylinders

lemma univ_mem_measurableSquareCylinders :
    (univ : Set (∀ i, X i)) ∈ measurableSquareCylinders ι X :=
  ⟨∅, fun _ ↦ univ, fun _ _ ↦ MeasurableSet.univ, by simp⟩

lemma _root_.MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents {s : Set ι} (hs : s ⊆ Δ) (hsc : s.Countable)
    {t : ∀ i, Set (X i)} (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (t i)) :
    MeasurableSet[cylinderEvents (X := X) Δ] (s.pi t) := by
  rw [pi_def]
  exact MeasurableSet.biInter hsc fun i hi ↦
    (ht i hi).preimage (measurable_cylinderEvent_apply (hs hi))

end MeasureTheory
end P1

section juxt
open MeasureTheory Set
variable {S E : Type*} {𝓔 : MeasurableSpace E} {Λ s : Set S} {t : S → Set E} {η : S → E} {x : S}

noncomputable def juxt (Λ : Set S) (η : S → E) (ζ : Λ → E) (x : S) : E := by
  classical exact dite (x ∈ Λ) (fun h ↦ ζ ⟨x, h⟩) (fun _ ↦ η x)

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_mem (hx : x ∈ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = ζ ⟨x, hx⟩ := by simp [juxt, hx]

@[simp]
lemma juxt_apply_of_not_mem (h : x ∉ Λ) (ζ : Λ → E) : juxt Λ η ζ x = η x := by simp [juxt, h]

protected lemma Measurable.juxt : Measurable (juxt Λ η) := by
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  rintro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Λ <;> simp [juxt, hx, measurable_pi_apply]

lemma preimage_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ := by
  ext ζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi]
  refine ⟨fun h j ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · split_ifs with hjs
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem j.property] using h _ hjs
    · simp
  · by_cases hiΛ : i ∈ Λ
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_mem hiΛ, hi] using h ⟨i, hiΛ⟩
    · simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hη i ⟨hi, hiΛ⟩

lemma preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty (hη : η ∉ (s \ Λ).pi t) :
    juxt Λ η ⁻¹' s.pi t = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro ζ hζ
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_pi] at hζ hη
  push Not at hη
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨his, hiΛ⟩, hit⟩ := hη
  exact hit <| by simpa [juxt_apply_of_not_mem hiΛ] using hζ i his

lemma map_juxt_pi [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (μ : Measure (Λ → E))
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (hs : s.Countable) (η : S → E) :
    μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) =
      ((s \ Λ).pi t).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ μ (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ)) η := by
  rw [Measure.map_apply .juxt (MeasurableSet.pi hs fun i _ ↦ ht i)]
  by_cases hη : η ∈ (s \ Λ).pi t
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi hη, indicator_of_mem hη]
  · rw [preimage_juxt_pi_eq_empty hη, measure_empty, indicator_of_notMem hη]

lemma measurable_map_juxt_pi (μ : Measure (Λ → E)) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i))
    (hs : s.Countable) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents (X := fun _ : S ↦ E) Λᶜ] fun η : S → E ↦
      μ.map (juxt Λ η) (s.pi t) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [map_juxt_pi μ ht hs]
  exact Measurable.indicator measurable_const
    (MeasurableSet.pi_cylinderEvents (fun _ h ↦ h.2) (hs.mono sdiff_subset) fun i _ ↦ ht i)

end juxt

namespace MeasureTheory

variable {α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {C : Set (Set α)} {μ ν : Measure α}

namespace Measure

lemma ext_of_generateFrom_of_univ

def IsConsistent (γ : ∀ Λ : Finset S, Kernel[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] (S → E) (S → E)) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃Λ₁ Λ₂⦄, Λ₁ ⊆ Λ₂ → (γ Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ γ Λ₂ = γ Λ₂

  toFun (Λ : Finset S) : Kernel[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] (S → E) (S → E)

noncomputable section ISSSD
variable {ν : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

instance isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi (Λ : Finset S) (η : S → E) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (juxt (Λ : Set S) η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map Measurable.juxt.aemeasurable

lemma measurable_isssdFun (Λ : Finset S) :
    Measurable[cylinderEvents Λᶜ]
      fun η : S → E ↦ (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν).map (juxt Λ η) := by
  refine @Measurable.measure_of_isPiSystem_of_isProbabilityMeasure _ _ _ _ _
    (fun η ↦ isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi (ν := ν) Λ η) _
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact measurable_map_juxt_pi (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
    (fun i ↦ ht i (mem_univ _)) s.countable_toSet

@[simps -fullyApplied]
def isssdFun (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (Λ : Finset S) :
    Kernel[cylinderEvents Λᶜ] (S → E) (S → E) :=
  @Kernel.mk _ _ (_) _
    (fun η ↦ Measure.map (juxt Λ η) (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν))
    (measurable_isssdFun (ν := ν) Λ)

instance instIsMarkovKernel_isssdFun {Λ : Finset S} : IsMarkovKernel (isssdFun ν Λ) :=
  ⟨fun η ↦ isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi (ν := ν) Λ η⟩

lemma isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E)
    (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) (η : S → E) :
    isssdFun ν Λ η ((s : Set S).pi t) =
      (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t).indicator (fun _ ↦ ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) η := by
  have hprod :
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Λ ↦ ν)
        (univ.pi fun j : Λ ↦ if (j : S) ∈ s then t j else univ) =
      ∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i) := by
    rw [Measure.pi_pi]
    simp only [apply_ite, measure_univ]
    exact (Finset.prod_attach Λ fun i : S ↦ if i ∈ s then ν (t i) else 1).trans <| by
      simp [Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.inter_comm]
  rw [isssdFun_apply, map_juxt_pi _ ht s.countable_toSet η]
  simp [Finset.coe_sdiff, hprod]

lemma lintegral_isssdFun_pi [DecidableEq S] {μ : Measure (S → E)}
    (Λ s : Finset S) (t : S → Set E) (ht : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) :
    ∫⁻ ω, isssdFun ν Λ ω ((s : Set S).pi t) ∂μ =
      (∏ i ∈ s ∩ Λ, ν (t i)) * μ (((s \ Λ : Finset S) : Set S).pi t) := by
  simp_rw [isssdFun_pi Λ s t ht]
  exact lintegral_indicator_const (MeasurableSet.pi (s \ Λ).countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht i) _

lemma isssdFun_comp_isssdFun [DecidableEq S] (Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S) :
    (isssdFun ν Λ₁).comap id (by exact cylinderEvents_le_pi) ∘ₖ isssdFun ν Λ₂ =
      (isssdFun ν (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)).comap id
        (measurable_id'' <| by gcongr; exact Finset.subset_union_right) := by
  refine DFunLike.ext _ _ fun η ↦ ext_of_generateFrom_of_isProbabilityMeasure
    generateFrom_measurableSquareCylinders.symm IsPiSystem.measurableSquareCylinders ?_
  rintro A ⟨s, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have ht' (i) : MeasurableSet (t i) := ht i (mem_univ _)
  rw [Kernel.comp_apply, Measure.bind_apply
    (MeasurableSet.pi s.countable_toSet fun i _ ↦ ht' i) (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  simp_rw [Kernel.comap_apply, id_eq]
  rw [lintegral_isssdFun_pi Λ₁ s t ht',
    isssdFun_pi Λ₂ (s \ Λ₁) t ht' η,
    isssdFun_pi (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂) s t ht' η, ← indicator_const_mul]
  congr 1
  · ext; simp
  ext
  rw [← Finset.prod_inter_mul_prod_sdiff (s ∩ (Λ₁ ∪ Λ₂)) Λ₁ fun i ↦ ν (t i)]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.inter_assoc, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 Finset.subset_union_left]
  · rw [Finset.inter_sdiff_assoc, Finset.union_sdiff_left, Finset.inter_comm,
      Finset.inter_sdiff_left_comm]

@[simps]
def isssd (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] : Specification S E where
  toFun := isssdFun ν
  isConsistent' Λ₁ Λ₂ hΛ := by
    classical
    rw [isssdFun_comp_isssdFun]
    ext a s _
    simp only [Kernel.comap_apply, id_eq, isssdFun_apply, Finset.coe_sort_coe]
    rw [Finset.union_eq_right.2 hΛ]

instance isssd.instIsMarkov : (isssd (S := S) ν).IsMarkov where
  isMarkovKernel Λ := ⟨fun η ↦ isProbabilityMeasure_map_juxt_pi (ν := ν) Λ η⟩

end ISSSD

name: Specification.IsPremodifier.isModifier_div
statement:
lemma IsPremodifier.isModifier_div (hρ : IsPremodifier ρ) (ν : Measure E)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hZ : ∀ Λ σ, 0 < ∫⁻ x, ρ Λ x ∂isssd ν Λ σ ∧ ∫⁻ x, ρ Λ x ∂isssd ν Λ σ < ⊤) :
    (isssd ν).IsModifier fun Λ σ ↦ ρ Λ σ / ∫⁻ x, ρ Λ x ∂isssd ν Λ σ

variable {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace β]

variable {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {s : Set α}

lemma measurable_restrict (hs : MeasurableSet s) : Measurable fun μ : Measure α ↦ μ.restrict s :=
  measurable_of_measurable_coe _ fun t ht ↦ by
    simp_rw [restrict_apply ht]; exact measurable_coe (ht.inter hs)

lemma measurable_setLIntegral {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Measurable fun μ : Measure α ↦ ∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ :=
  (measurable_lintegral hf).comp (measurable_restrict hs)

lemma bind_null {m : Measure α} {f : α → Measure β} {s : Set β}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf : AEMeasurable f m) :
    m.bind f s = 0 ↔ (fun a ↦ f a s) =ᵐ[m] 0 := by
  rw [bind_apply hs hf]

    (measurable_coe hs).comp_aemeasurable hf

theorem ae_bind_iff {m : Measure α} {f : α → Measure β} {p : β → Prop}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f m) (hp : MeasurableSet {x | p x}) :
    (∀ᵐ b ∂m.bind f, p b) ↔ ∀ᵐ a ∂m, ∀ᵐ b ∂f a, p b :=
  ⟨ae_ae_of_ae_bind hf, fun h ↦ by
    rwa [ae_iff, bind_null _ hf] at *
    exact hp.compl⟩
